Bad review. Before you can even get into the app NOT log in, not start a walk, literally just open it from your home screen you’re forced to watch an ad. Every. Single. Time.

People need to understand this: watching ads makes the app money. So they’re getting paid just for you trying to open the app, whether you earn anything or not.

And it doesn’t stop there. Even after you complete the required walks or steps, the app does not actually give you the coins like it claims. Instead, it adds extra steps, extra conditions, and more hoops to jump through after you already did what was required.

So you walk, you watch ads, you “complete” goals and then surprise, you still don’t get paid unless you do more things (which usually involve… more ads).

This feels intentionally misleading and designed to farm ad revenue, not to reward users for walking. If you’re looking for an app that actually pays you fairly for activity, this is not it.
